info.name: UniMate API v1
info.description:
Express app in server/src/app.js. PORT defaults to 5000 (env.port). All module routes are mounted under /api/v1 via server/src/routes/index.js.

**Response envelope** — Every handler responds through utils/response.js. Success = { success: true, data: <payload> }. Error = { success: false, error: { message, type, code } }.

**Auth** — JWT HS256 signed with JWT_SECRET. Access token expires in 1d, refresh token in 7d. Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. middlewares/auth.middleware.js re-checks the user still exists and is_active on every request.

**Roles** — super_admin inherits admin (constants/roles.js). Any gate listing 'admin' also accepts 'super_admin'.

**Validation** — Joi via middlewares/validate.middleware.js with stripUnknown:true and allowUnknown:false — unknown body/query keys are stripped, schema violations return 400.

**Rate limits** — Global: 100 requests / 15 min per IP. Login routes (/auth/login/*, /auth/login): 5 requests / 15 min per IP.

**CORS** — Origin restricted to env FRONTEND_URL (default http://localhost:3000).

Run any login request first: its test script saves the access token into the `{{token}}` collection variable, which every authenticated request reuses.

request.description: Student role only. Without ?date returns the weekly timetable grouped by day. With ?date=YYYY-MM-DD returns a flat, exception-resolved list of that day's classes (cancellations, reschedules and extra classes applied). Student role only. Writes target_cgpa and study_intensity onto the students row (COALESCE — omitted fields keep their current value). At least one field is required; targetCgpa must be 0-4. study_intensity is a free-text column with no DB enum, so it is only length-bounded (max 30 chars).

Admin or teacher (owned offerings only). 400 if the student is not actively enrolled or score > max_score. For assessment_type in (assignment, quiz, presentation, project) a reference_id pointing at an assignment in the same offering is REQUIRED, and title/max_score are overwritten from that assignment; for the other types (sessional, midterm, final, practical) title and max_score are required in the body. Upserts on (enrollment_id, reference_id) or (enrollment_id, assessment_type).
Admin or teacher (owned offerings only). Paginated, ordered by roll number then assessment type.

Admin, teacher (owned offerings only) or student. A student may only request their own studentId — anything else is 403. Applies the offering's mid/sessional/final/practical weights, then rounds up (Math.ceil) to the final marks and maps to a letter grade and grade point.
